name: aces-archiving-system
description: Thesis and Capstone Archiving and Scheduling Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run watch:css --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy: git pull && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=768' npm run install:all -- --no-audit --no-fund && npm run migrate && npm run build && (pm2 restart archiving-dnsc || pm2 start npm --name 'archiving-dnsc' --cwd ./backend -- start) && pm2 save
